operation_details.item: The user's joint venture has LogiCore providing the logistics side.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Quick JV check-in: who is covering which piece of the operation?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: TechNova provides the technology platform, and LogiCore provides the logistics side of our joint venture.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That split is refreshingly clear. Is the board cadence still monthly?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the JV board meets monthly.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. And the contract is still on an annual renewal cycle?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the JV contract renews annually.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Perfect—technology with TechNova, logistics with LogiCore, monthly board oversight, and annual renewal. Nice and manageable.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. Keeping the operating model simple helps the board discussion.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that LogiCore provides the JV's logistics, but keep the technology partner, board, and contract details.
